Policy decisions happen on the mailing list and the matrix and anyone can join it. Everyone in this room could join it today and give Ken a heart attack.
Any recording is better than no recording. The worst thing is no recording. But the better the audio is, the more appealing it is for people to listen to.

notes.summary: Murph presents an overview of Hacker Public Radio (HPR) at the Open Libre Free Conference, explaining its community-driven nature, how to listen and contribute, and technical tips for recording shows. He covers HPR's structure, content diversity, submission process, and backend infrastructure. This episode will interest podcast listeners, open source enthusiasts, and potential contributors to community media projects.
